DALAILUL KHAIRATH ISLAMIC FOUNDATION (REGD.) CHAPTER 1: INSTITUTIONAL PROFILE • Spiritual Heritage & Genesis
OFFICIAL ERP MANUAL 2026

Dalailul Khairath Islamic Foundation (Regd.)

Genesis, founding vision, and the sacred legacy at Kakkidippuram Main Campus

HISTORICAL PROFILE

Sacred Roots & Historical Genesis

Established at the serene academic valley of Kakkidippuram (P.O. Alamkode, Malappuram Dt., Kerala), Dalailul Khairath Islamic Foundation was instituted to nurture authentic Islamic scholarship, preserve Prophetic traditions, and shelter vulnerable orphans with unconditional familial warmth.

Founded under the spiritual inspiration of classical masters, the foundation pays solemn homage to patron saint Marhoom K. P. Moitheen Musliyar, whose vision of holistic spiritual knowledge continues to illuminate every lecture hall, library corridor, and prayer circle.

Aerial perspective of the sprawling academic campus complex in Kakkidippuram

Spiritual Sanctuary

Hosting daily congregational devotions, classical Dars circles, and spiritual Dhikr Majlis at Masjid Zainab.

Academic Rigor

Affiliated with Jamia Madeenathunnoor, integrating Dawa sciences with contemporary academic disciplines.

Humanitarian Care

Providing 100% free residential boarding, nourishment, healthcare, and mentorship for orphan scholars.

Foundational Pillars & Institutional Charter

1. Preservation of Sacred Knowledge: Imparting classical Arabic sciences, Fiqh jurisprudence, and Hadith commentary under renowned scholars.

2. Total Orphan Sponsorship: Ensuring every admitted child receives dignity, parental affection, world-class healthcare, and life enablement.
3. Social Harmony & Community Upliftment: Bridging community needs through educational scholarships, welfare outreach, and disaster relief.

4. Institutional Governance: Operating under registered Trust bylaws (Reg No: 326/IV/2019) with audited financial transparency.

DALAILUL KHAIRATH ISLAMIC FOUNDATION (REGD.) CHAPTER 2: ERP SYSTEM ARCHITECTURE • Digital Ecosystem Overview
OFFICIAL ERP MANUAL 2026

DALAIL FAMILY ERP: System Architecture

Cloud-native, role-segregated digital infrastructure uniting campuses and field squads

SYSTEM INFRASTRUCTURE

Why DALAIL FAMILY ERP Was Built

Managing a multi-campus institution with hundreds of traveling student collection squads required moving beyond vulnerable physical receipt books and delayed postal remittances. DALAIL FAMILY ERP was engineered as a zero-latency, cloud-native platform providing instant digital WhatsApp receipts, cryptographic QR verification, dynamic leaderboard rankings, and tamper-proof financial settlements.

1. Public Experience

Open to donors and patrons globally. Features live student/group leaderboards, verified YouTube media, campus profiles, and instant online receipt validation.

2. Student Field Portal

Mobile-optimized PWA for field representatives. Allows offline-ready donation receipt generation, assigned route maps, student ID cards, and collection histories.

3. Campus Administration

Dedicated regional command center. Campus Admins supervise squads, dispatch brochure kits, issue ID cards, verify cash/UPI handovers, and generate audit reports.

Technical Ecosystem Blueprint

NEXT.JS 14
React Server Components & High-Speed Edge Rendering
SECURE DB
Cloud persistence with zero-loss local recovery caching
WHATSAPP API
Automated receipt delivery to donor phone numbers
PWA ENGINE
Standalone Android installation without browser address bar
Data Security Guarantee: All personal donor records and financial collections are encrypted. Client-side role tampering is strictly blocked through authenticated server-side role verification.

DALAILUL KHAIRATH ISLAMIC FOUNDATION (REGD.) CHAPTER 5: PUBLIC VERIFICATION • Cryptographic QR & Identity Validation
OFFICIAL ERP MANUAL 2026

Public Verification Engine: Zero Fraud Safeguard

Instant QR validation for donor receipts and official student representative ID cards

SECURITY PROTOCOL

Receipt Verification Engine

Every single donation receipt generated by DALAIL FAMILY ERP contains an encrypted QR code and unique alphanumeric ID (e.g., REC-2026-0042). Scanning the QR code takes the donor directly to:

https://dalail-family-erp.vercel.app/verify/receipt/[id]

The page displays verified donor name, amount, date/time stamp, receiving student identity, official digital seal, and signature. Tampered receipts fail instantly.

Public Receipt Verification page confirming genuine transaction

Student Identity Card Verification (/verify/id/[id])

Donors approached by field workers can scan the QR code printed on the student's chest badge. The public portal instantly verifies:

  • Full official student name and photograph.
  • Active registration status and campus affiliation.
  • Official authorization letter and campus helpline number.
Anti-Impersonation Warning:
Never hand over cash or donations to any representative whose ID card fails digital QR verification on dalail-family-erp.vercel.app. Report suspicious activity immediately to our official Help Desk helpline.

OFFICIAL ERP MANUAL 2026

Unified Authentication Gateway (/login)

Seamless sign-in with server-side role resolution and WhatsApp password recovery

SECURITY ARCHITECTURE
Streamlined Login Interface with automated credential routing

Single Login Interface (Zero Manual Role Pickers)

In strict compliance with modern cybersecurity protocols, manual role buttons (Main Admin / Campus Admin / Student) have been eliminated. Users enter only:

  • Identifier: Username, Student ID, or Registered Mobile Number.
  • Password: Secure encrypted credential.

Upon authentication, the server securely determines the user's role and immediately redirects them to their authorized dashboard.

Automatic Role Redirection Matrix

Authenticated Role Target Destination Access Permissions & Restrictions
MAIN ADMIN /admin Statewide campus governance, financial audits, dispatches, public media controls.
CAMPUS ADMIN /campus-admin Strictly isolated to assigned campus. Student directory, squads, local dispatches.
STUDENT /student Field route, receipt generation, student ID card, personal collection history.
WhatsApp Password Recovery Protocol:

Users who forget their credentials click "Forgot Password". The system verifies their registered phone number and automatically dispatches a secure reset link from our verified official WhatsApp sender: +91 8547931509.

Step-by-Step Donation Collection Workflow

Standard operating procedure for issuing instant digital receipts in the field

OPERATIONAL WORKFLOW

Step 1: Enter Donor Information

Open the "New Collection Entry" card on the Student Portal. Fill in donor details accurately:

  • Donor Name: Full formal name for receipt generation.
  • Mobile / WhatsApp: 10-digit number for automatic receipt SMS/WhatsApp.
  • Locality / Address: City, house name, or mahall area.

Step 2: Purpose & Amount Category

Select the designated institutional fund:

General Donation
Campus maintenance & Dars
Orphan Sponsorship
Food, clothing & schooling
Building Complex
Masjid Zainab construction
Zakat & Sadaqah
Sharia-compliant welfare

Step 3: Payment Method & Verification

Specify the exact transaction mode received:

A

UPI / Google Pay / PhonePe

Scan official Dalail QR. Enter transaction UTR number into the ERP field.

B

Direct Cash Handover

Count physical notes carefully. Store in sealed foundation security pouch.

Step 4: Submission & Receipt Delivery

Tap the large blue "Generate & Send Digital Receipt" button:

  • Cryptographic receipt ID is generated instantly.
  • Automated WhatsApp message is dispatched to donor.
  • Student collection total updates on personal dashboard.
  • Entry synchronizes with Campus Admin audit queue.

End-of-Campaign Final Settlement Protocol

Upon conclusion of regional collection rounds, all collected cash is deposited into the designated Foundation Bank Account. The bank counterfoil receipt is uploaded to the ERP portal to close out the campus campaign settlement.

Progressive Web App: Android Installation

Installing DALAIL FAMILY ERP as a native standalone app without browser URL bars

PWA INSTALLATION

True Standalone App Experience

DALAIL FAMILY ERP is configured with a high-performance Service Worker and Web App Manifest (manifest.json). When installed, it launches directly from the Android home-screen icon:

  • Zero Chrome address bar, browser tabs, or navigation buttons.
  • Standard Android system status bar and navigation bar preserved.
  • Instant offline startup utilizing local asset caching.

Step-by-Step Android Installation Guide

1

Open Chrome on Android

Navigate to https://dalail-family-erp.vercel.app/

2

Tap "Install App" Button

Tap the [App] install button in the header or Chrome menu [Add to Home screen].

3

Confirm Installation

Tap [Install]. Android automatically builds and places the Dalail ERP app icon.

4

Launch from App Drawer

Open the app icon. The ERP now runs in full standalone native view.

Troubleshooting Stuck WebAPK Installations

If Android displays an endless "Installing Dalail ERP..." notification in the shade, clear Chrome's cache: Settings → Apps → Chrome → Storage → Clear Cache. Ensure cellular data is active during the 30-second initial WebAPK compilation.

OFFICIAL ERP MANUAL 2026

Troubleshooting & Operational FAQs

Verified solutions for common field issues encountered by students and campus admins

KNOWLEDGEBASE

Q1: Login fails or shows "Invalid Credentials"?

Ensure username or 10-digit mobile number is entered without spaces or +91 prefix. If password is forgotten, tap "Forgot Password" to receive an instant WhatsApp reset link.

Q2: Donor did not receive WhatsApp receipt?

Open "Collection History" in Student Portal, locate the receipt entry, and tap "Re-send WhatsApp". Check that the donor's WhatsApp number is active and has international messaging enabled.

Q3: Cellular network is lost in remote areas?

The PWA stores receipt entries in local encrypted browser memory. Continue recording collections; when cellular connectivity resumes, tap [Refresh] to sync all records with the cloud.

Q4: How do I change student squad assignments?

Only the Campus Admin can re-assign squad members. Navigate to /campus-admin/groups, select the squad, remove the student, and add them to their new squad.

Q5: Receipt appears twice in settlement?

Duplicate entries are prevented by unique transaction hashes. If an erroneous duplicate entry occurs, Campus Admin can mark it "Under Review" to exclude it from leaderboard calculation.

Q6: How to install without Chrome address bar?

Launch the app exclusively from the Android home-screen icon installed via PWA, not by opening Chrome and typing the URL. This guarantees full standalone view.
